name: Future Rule
definition: Timing characteristics of the maturity of the future.

TimeType.name: Time Type
TimeType.definition: Indicates whether the time to maturity is measured in months or years.

MaximumTimeToMaturity.name: Maximum Time To Maturity
MaximumTimeToMaturity.definition: Maximum number of time types up to maturity or first redemption option.

MinimumTimeToMaturity.name: Minimum Time To Maturity
MinimumTimeToMaturity.definition: Minimum number of time types up to maturity or first redemption option.

BaseInterestRate.name: Base Interest Rate
BaseInterestRate.definition: Nominal interest rate of synthetic bond.

RelatedFutureInstrument.name: Related Future Instrument
RelatedFutureInstrument.definition: Future instrument for which a rule is specified.
